text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"A has multiple run-on sentences and comma splices","quality":"sentence control","description":"This captures the ability to form clear, bounded sentences without stringing many clauses together in ways that obscure the structure."},{"evidence":"B uses a clearer paragraph opening, body, and conclusion structure","quality":"organizational coherence","description":"This captures how well the essay groups ideas and moves through them in an easy-to-follow progression."},{"evidence":"B's claims are stated in a more general, sustained way","quality":"idea development","description":"This captures the ability to build and extend a central point rather than relying mainly on examples and repetition."},{"evidence":"B uses transitions like \"however\" and \"in conclusion\"","quality":"discourse control","description":"This captures the use of linking words and signposting to guide the reader through relationships among ideas."},{"evidence":"B maintains a more academic, reflective tone","quality":"register control","description":"This captures a more appropriate formal style for an argumentative school essay."},{"evidence":"B has fewer distracting word-level errors overall","quality":"language accuracy","description":"This captures cleaner grammar, spelling, and phrasing that interfere less with comprehension."}]}
